summary: Iter59 — Postponed orders in delivery sessions + Préparation Kanban/Table views. Backend 2/2 passed (test_iter59_postpone.py): PATCH /orders/{oid}/status with next_date correctly flips order to status=confirmee, rider_id/session_id=null, rescheduled_for/delivery_date=next_date, writes session.postponed.{oid}.to; invalid date -> 400, past date -> 400; today accepted. GET /delivery-sessions returns orders_detail with postponed_to, postponed_count=1, total_to_collect/delivered_count/collected_total EXCLUDE the postponed order. PATCH /delivery-sessions/{sid}/close is NOT blocked by postponed orders (returns 200). Frontend Préparation (/console/preparation): prep-view-switch with 3 buttons (cards/table/kanban), persistence in localStorage prep_view works (reload keeps selection), prep-table renders 26 rows with prep-row-{code}+prep-start-{code}, prep-kanban renders 4 columns prep-col-{nouvelle,confirmee,en_preparation,prete} with prep-kcard-{code} cards (117 total), drag card DN-261006-4340 from 'nouvelle' to 'confirmee' moved it successfully (toast shown). Frontend DeliveryDays (/console/livraisons) day detail: postponed chip 'Reportée au 12/10' rendered with data-testid 'postponed-DN-261010-2348' on Affectation+Suivi+Réconciliation tabs; 1 line-through td on Réconciliation; 1 'Hors encaissement (reportée)' Versement cell; postponed order correctly EXCLUDED from today's 'Commandes prêtes' list (DD 10/10 < rescheduled 12/10). Clôturer la journée button not disabled. Rider app (rider1@dinastore.ci): status-reschedule button opens postpone-form with postpone-date (type=date, min=2026-10-10 = today), postpone-reason input, postpone-confirm button. Deliveries page (/console/journees-livraison) 'Journées livreurs' tab shows the chip. However, Board d'affectation tab exhibits 2 UI bugs described below.

ui_bugs.component: Deliveries.jsx — Board d'affectation / À assigner column
ui_bugs.issue: Line 51: toShip = orders.filter(o => ['prete','confirmee','nouvelle'].includes(o.status) && !o.rider_id) does NOT filter out postponed orders whose rescheduled_for is still in the future. As a result, a just-postponed order (status=confirmee, rider_id=null, rescheduled_for=2026-10-12) appears IMMEDIATELY in today's 'À assigner' column, violating the spec « revient dans les commandes à affecter de la journée du [date] (pas avant) ». Expected additional filter: && (!o.rescheduled_for || o.rescheduled_for <= todayIso())

Lines 141-152 render each session item (o of sess.orders_detail) in rider columns WITHOUT showing the postponed chip or strikethrough. Postponed order DN-261010-2348 appears under Kouamé Serge column as plain 'Confirmée · COD 12,345 FCFA' with no 'Reportée au 12/10' chip and no line-through on the amount — inconsistent with the sessions-tab table (line 197) which does apply line-through, and with DeliveryDays which renders the chip correctly. Should display VersementCell/OrderDayStatus chip when o.postponed_to is set, like the other views.

issues: Pre-existing React hydration warning <span> inside <option> (dev-tool x-component wrapper, non-blocking, carried over since iter56).

action_items: Deliveries.jsx line 51: add `&& (!o.rescheduled_for || o.rescheduled_for <= new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10))` to toShip filter so postponed orders don't appear in today's À assigner column.

Deliveries.jsx lines 141-152 (board rider column item): render a 'Reportée au DD/MM' chip (postponed-{code}) and apply strikethrough on the amount when o.postponed_to is truthy, mirroring the DeliveryDays detail view and the sessions-tab table.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py update_order_status: nd < today check compares against UTC date — if the server timezone differs from Abidjan (UTC+0, same) this is fine; but using datetime.now(timezone.utc).date() can accept a date that is still 'yesterday' locally in other TZs. For a strictly local-date check consider using Africa/Abidjan explicitly.

server.py update_order_status: when postponing, upd['status']='reportee' is set first then overwritten to 'confirmee' at line 699 — the timeline entry already captured 'reportee', so the status transition is traceable. OK but slightly surprising; a comment would help.

Preparation.jsx drag-and-drop uses raw HTML5 DnD on prep-kcard-{code} — no visible drop indicator for 'prete' column aside from ring color. UX note: cards in 'prete' col are intentionally non-draggable (correct per spec), but there is no tooltip explaining why. Minor polish.
routers/riders.py list_sessions: active list filters `o['id'] not in postponed`, but orders_detail still contains postponed orders tagged with postponed_to — good. Totals exclusion verified.

success_rate.frontend: ~85% (Préparation 100%, DeliveryDays 100%, Rider postpone 100%, Deliveries board 2 UI gaps)

rca of the issue: Deliveries board 'À assigner' bug: Postponing an order resets rider_id=null and status=confirmee server-side (correct), but DeliveryDays correctly adds the rescheduled_for exclusion in its ready filter (line 177) while Deliveries.jsx uses an older filter (line 51) that only checks status + rider_id. The sessions-tab table in Deliveries DOES handle postponed_to visually (line 197) because it iterates session.orders_detail which still carries the order with postponed_to attached by the backend; the Board rider column (lines 141-152) iterates the same orders_detail but omits that visual treatment.
